notes: «الإمام» at the start is the compiler's title, not a link; «- شك في ذلك أبو غانم -» is an editor's gloss between dashes, left out; «مجاهد أو عمن حدثه عن مجاهد» gives an alternative: Mujahid directly, or an unnamed «عمن حدثه» who narrated from Mujahid; the main reading takes Mujahid directly as written and the unnamed alternative needs a ruling; «لا تفعلوا فعل أهل الكتاب» is the Prophet's saying quoted by Ibn Umar, so the Companion is the last link
